issues.explanation: In this classical construction, 之 is a grammatical particle meaning “of,” while 后 means “descendant.” Grouping them hides a useful particle and may be confused with modern 之后 (“after”).
issues.suggested_fix: Split into 之 (particle: of) and 后 (descendant).

issues.explanation: The gloss is a dictionary-variant note rather than a useful explanation of 岁 in 二十八岁.
After 五百, 多 means “more than,” not simply “many.”
Here 给 is the verb “to give” or “to assign,” referring to assigning Liu Bei another thousand soldiers; “to” is misleadingly incomplete.
风火 is not the unit in this context. The text contains 大风 (“strong wind”) followed by 火攻 (“to attack with fire”), so the current span crosses two natural words and hides 火攻.
issues.suggested_fix: Segment as 大风 and 火攻, with meanings “strong wind” and “fire attack; to attack with fire.”
